nodes.label: Chromatin
nodes.rationale: DNA associated with histones and other proteins; dynamic substrate for regulation.

nodes.label: Nucleosome
nodes.rationale: DNA wrapped around a histone octamer (H2A, H2B, H3, H4).

nodes.label: Chromatin Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Ability of molecules to reach and interact with chromatinized DNA; probe-dependent.

nodes.label: Epigenetics
nodes.rationale: Stable, heritable phenotype associated with chromosomal changes without DNA sequence alteration.

nodes.label: DNA Methylation
nodes.rationale: Chemical modification (e.g., 5mC) of DNA bases, often at CpG sites.

nodes.label: Histone Modifications
nodes.rationale: Chemical modifications of histone tails (e.g., H3K4me3, H3K27ac) affecting chromatin state.

nodes.label: scRNA-seq
nodes.rationale: Measurement of sampled RNA molecules from isolated cells.

nodes.label: Cell Identity
nodes.rationale: Persistent organization of molecular programs and functions; distinct from transient state.

nodes.label: Cell Lineage
nodes.rationale: History of descent through cell divisions; directional ancestor-descendant relationship.

nodes.label: Enhancer-Promoter Interaction
nodes.rationale: Physical or functional relationship between distal enhancers and target promoters.

nodes.label: Gene Regulatory Network
nodes.rationale: Abstraction of relationships among regulators (TFs) and gene outputs.

nodes.label: Spatial Transcriptomics
nodes.rationale: Assignment of molecular observations to positions in a tissue section.

nodes.label: Dataset A1 (Lymph Node)
nodes.rationale: 10x Visium RNA and protein co-profiling of human lymph node.

nodes.label: ASTRA Operating Rules
nodes.rationale: Consolidates standing project instructions, governance-recovery requests, and phase-specific procedures.

nodes.label: Project Brief
nodes.rationale: Primary research agent instructions and project scope definition.

nodes.label: Project README
nodes.rationale: Top-level project orientation and status.

nodes.label: Research Master
nodes.rationale: Central document for scope, questions, and phase gates.

nodes.label: Research Questions
nodes.rationale: Categorized list of established, open, and exploratory research questions.

nodes.label: Source Policy
nodes.rationale: Rules for source priority, citation, and code verification.

nodes.label: Biology Fundamentals and Omics Foundations
nodes.rationale: Roadmap for molecular biology, gene regulation, and cellular foundations.

nodes.label: Component Terminology
nodes.rationale: Operational naming conventions for biological and computational stages.

nodes.label: Research Log
nodes.rationale: Chronological record of research decisions, evidence, and outcomes.

nodes.label: Workspace Inventory
nodes.rationale: Audit of local and external resources found during bootstrap.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Report
nodes.rationale: Records the initialization of the research environment and repository structure.

nodes.label: Dataset Documentation Schema
nodes.rationale: Defines required metadata fields for dataset registration and validation.

nodes.label: Future Experiment Protocol
nodes.rationale: Defines the immutable run record and evaluation rules for future experiments.

nodes.label: Method Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Organizational scaffold for statistical and machine learning method families.

nodes.label: Paper Extraction Schema
nodes.rationale: Standardized schema for extracting information from scientific literature.

nodes.label: Representation Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Unranked taxonomy of computational representation families for multi-omics data.

nodes.label: Multilayer Perceptron (MLP)
nodes.rationale: Foundational neural architecture composing affine maps and nonlinear activations.

nodes.label: Deterministic Autoencoder
nodes.rationale: Uses encoder and decoder functions for nonlinear compression and reconstruction.

nodes.label: Deep Count Autoencoder (DCA)
nodes.rationale: Models single-cell RNA counts using negative-binomial mean/dispersion and zero-inflation.

nodes.label: Variational Autoencoder (VAE)
nodes.rationale: Probabilistic generative model optimizing the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO).

nodes.label: scVI
nodes.rationale: Models scRNA-seq counts with a variational encoder and count decoder, accounting for batch and depth.

nodes.label: totalVI
nodes.rationale: Jointly models paired RNA and antibody-derived protein (ADT) counts with background handling.

nodes.label: MultiVI
nodes.rationale: Integrates paired and unpaired RNA-ATAC observations using modality-specific encoders.

nodes.label: BABEL
nodes.rationale: Interoperable RNA and ATAC encoders/decoders for cross-modal translation.

nodes.label: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
nodes.rationale: Mechanism using Queries, Keys, and Values to aggregate contextual information.

nodes.label: Transformer Block
nodes.rationale: Combines multi-head attention, FFN, residuals, and normalization.

nodes.label: Geneformer
nodes.rationale: Transformer encoder using ranked gene sequences for masked identity prediction.

nodes.label: scGPT
nodes.rationale: Generative transformer pretrained on over 33 million cells using gene/value encodings.

nodes.label: Biology to Data
nodes.rationale: Defines the measurement bridge from biological sample to data matrix.

nodes.label: Sinkhorn Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Iterative scaling procedure to solve entropic optimal transport.

nodes.label: GSVA
nodes.rationale: Nonparametric method for gene-set enrichment scoring.

nodes.label: MIDAS
nodes.rationale: Addresses mosaic RNA/ADT/ATAC integration with information-theoretic disentanglement.

nodes.label: SimCLR
nodes.rationale: Foundational contrastive learning framework using augmentations and projection heads.

nodes.label: InfoNCE
nodes.rationale: Contrastive loss objective based on identifying a positive sample among negatives.

nodes.label: Message Passing GNN
nodes.rationale: Aggregates neighbor features to update node embeddings based on adjacency.

nodes.label: scGLUE
nodes.rationale: Integrates RNA and ATAC using a guidance graph as a biological prior.

nodes.label: SpatialGlue
nodes.rationale: Spatial multi-omics GNN producing spot embeddings conditional on a spatial graph.

nodes.label: Canonical Method Inventory
nodes.rationale: Classifies methods into foundational, representation, and integration categories.

nodes.label: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
nodes.rationale: Derived in toy calculations using covariance matrix and eigendecomposition.

nodes.label: Orthonormal Eigenbasis
nodes.rationale: Real symmetric matrices (like covariance) have real eigenvalues and an orthonormal eigenbasis.

nodes.label: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF)
nodes.rationale: Constrains factors W and H to be nonnegative.

nodes.label: L1 and L2 Regularization
nodes.rationale: L1 (Lasso) promotes sparsity; L2 (Ridge) shrinks coefficients.

nodes.label: Sparse PCA
nodes.rationale: Adds L1 penalty to PCA to encourage zero coefficients.

nodes.label: Kernel PCA
nodes.rationale: Performs PCA in a high-dimensional feature space defined by a kernel.

nodes.label: Affine Map
nodes.rationale: Defined as z = Wx + b; linear only if b=0.

nodes.label: Matrix Rank
nodes.rationale: Dimension of column space, equal to row space; rank(X) <= min(n, p).

nodes.label: Independent Component Analysis (ICA)
nodes.rationale: Assumes latent sources are statistically independent.

nodes.label: Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)
nodes.rationale: Maximizes correlation between paired views X and Y.

nodes.label: Abstract Simplicial Complex
nodes.rationale: A collection of vertex subsets closed under taking subsets, distinguishing filled triangles from pairwise boundaries.

nodes.label: Hypergraph
nodes.rationale: A graph structure where edges can connect any number of vertices, not restricted by simplicial closure rules.

nodes.label: Cobolt
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical latent count model for multimodal integration using multinomial likelihoods.

nodes.label: Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)
nodes.rationale: Couples feature learning with soft Student-t cluster assignments.

links.rationale: Entropic OT uses entropy regularization H(Pi).
